featured artist of the month: Xine Hann

November's SEARCH featured artist is Xine Hann, an Orlando graphic designer, 3D collage artist and the founder of Orlando Collage Club.

Featured Artist November 9, 2026 · 2 min read

mail club · featured artist · collage · orlando artists

hi friends!! we are so happy to announce that november's featured artist of the month is Xine Hann!! Xine is a pillar of the creative community here in Central Florida as the founder/ director of Orlando Collage Club! Crazy! I know! You may have even been to one of their events already! If not, definitely check one out! Here is a bit more about Xine Hann:

Hi, my name is Xine. I am a mom and graphic designer in Central Florida.

After earning a degree from Stetson University, I travelled to New Jersey and then Hawaii, learning tattoo design, zines, block printing, and a little about the wood arts.

Over the past several years, I’ve focused on improving my collage skills, developing my own style of 3D collage artwork.

Recently, I started the Orlando Collage Club to share this passion with others. If you’re curious to know more about Orlando Collage Club, you can find us on Instagram and Facebook @OrlandoCollageClub. You can also find more of my work on Instagram @Xine_Hann.

Source: Xine Hann at Avalon Arts Center

thank you for choosing to support our local arts and culture scene! artists in our community deserve our support! be sure to head over to @xine_hann and show your support by liking or sharing a post!

if you are new here, every month we showcase a local artist by sending some of their work to you by mail, making supporting local a part of your monthly routine! Join the mail club

talk to you soon,

-SEARCH
